lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 10 distinct high-contrast vertical white lines traversing the torso mass, spaced at approximately regular intervals across the lateral field.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The third and fourth lines from the posterior flank are truncated, terminating at the mid-torso level rather than extending to the ventral boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 6-8 distinct white spots is visible on the lower haunch area, concentrated above the hock joint.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Horns follow a lyrate spiral, angling outwards and backwards from the skull before curving inwards and upwards towards the apex.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between the terminal horn tips is approximately 2.5 times the width of the individual horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: Bright ivory tipping accounts for approximately 15% of the total visible vertical length of each horn.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a Red-billed Oxpecker (Buphagus erythrorhynchus) on the lower right neck; prominent white dorsal mane and transverse white facial chevron between the eyes.
